notes: Security: WiFi backups now travel over HTTPS (free Let's Encrypt cert via Caddy+sslip.io) instead of plain HTTP - photos, SMS, contacts and the auth key were previously sniffable by anyone on the same WiFi. Cleartext traffic is now blocked app-wide. Server also refuses uploads when the VPS disk drops below a 2GB safety margin, so a big phone backup can't take down other services sharing the box.
